source_tests: HumanEval+ (EvalPlus, Liu et al. 2023, Apache-2.0, https://github.com/evalplus/evalplus), HumanEval/0 from https://huggingface.co/datasets/evalplus/humanevalplus
statement: Given a list of floating-point numbers and a threshold, decide whether any two different elements of the list (two different positions) are closer to each other than the threshold, that is, their absolute difference is strictly smaller than the threshold.
rust_signature: fn has_close_elements(numbers: Vec<f64>, threshold: f64) -> bool
